model.rationale: Norcross is a well-funded incumbent in a D+10 district, while Republican Damon Galdo has raised under $16K with no outside support, and markets price the race around 96% Democratic. overview:
Donald Norcross seeks another term in a South Jersey district that leans Democratic by about ten points. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, roughly $2.4 million on hand, after raising more than $1.6 million. Republican Damon Galdo has raised about $16,000 and has minimal cash, with no outside spending on either side.

No public polls cover the race, and no expert raters have published ratings. Prediction markets put the Democratic win probability near 96 percent. The combination of incumbency, district lean, and the fundraising gap points to a comfortable Democratic hold, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
